subject.title: fix(codex): suppress stdout/stderr stream errors in sandbox subprocesses

question: Does the current exact-head implementation preserve the same output-stream and close-finalization contract as the sibling Codex exec-server after this PR’s stream-error settlement changes?
rationale: OpenClaw policy makes direct sibling-Codex source inspection a hard prerequisite for a Codex verdict; this review cannot substitute PR prose or wrapper behavior for that audit.

options.title: Audit then approve

options.title: Require lifecycle adjustment
options.body: Request a narrow follow-up only if the Codex audit shows stream errors can duplicate terminal handling or finalize an execution lease before child close.
